response.sql: WITH fielding_with_bats AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, 'Unknown') as batting_hand, COUNT(*) as count FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, 'Unknown')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(count) as average_count FROM fielding_with_bats), with_stats AS (SELECT fwb.batting_hand, fwb.count, CAST(fwb.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share, fwb.count - t.average_count as above_average FROM fielding_with_bats fwb CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT batting_hand, count, share, above_average FROM with_stats WHERE count > (SELECT average_count FROM totals) ORDER BY count DESC
